sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact post-trained vision-language model card still labels its language model nominally 9B. Its language and vision-language comparison tables report benchmark results without total/activated-parameter rows; no separate active count is stated. Native context 262144; text, image and video inputs; thinking and tool-call examples.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration with vision encoder and 32 dense text layers, FFN intermediate size 12288 and one MTP layer. No routed experts or declared active-parameter count.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B raw model card, October 27 recheck
sources.evidence: Complete raw card rechecked for parameter and activation statements: nominal language-model size 9B, language and vision-language benchmark tables, and optional MTP serving commands; no separately defined activated-parameter count. sources.title: Official Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B benchmark comparison graphic
sources.evidence: Downloaded and visually inspected the comparison graphic linked from the current official Qwen repository: eight benchmark panels identify Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B but contain no total or activated-parameter row or axis.

sources.title: SiliconFlow Qwen3.5-9B listing, secondary search lead
sources.evidence: Secondary provider listing labels both total and activated parameters 9B. It does not define the active-count scope or attribute that count to a Qwen statement; its model-source link leads to the exact Qwen card, which does not report an activated count. Recorded as a search lead, not accepted as developer evidence.

name.note: Display spelling of the official Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint.

developer.note: The official Qwen repository identifies Qwen team, Alibaba Group.

family.note: This exact checkpoint belongs to the Qwen3.5 series within Qwen.

release_date.note: Explicit exact-variant public-availability announcement; replaces February 23.

open_weights.note: Public post-trained checkpoint shards are downloadable.

license.note: SPDX spelling of the checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint remains 9.653104368B stored parameters, freshly reconfirmed by repository metadata. Preserve the previous header-derived components: language model including LM head 8.953803264B, vision 0.456010480B, MTP 0.243290624B. Qwen separately publishes the nominal 9B language-model label; no tensor recount was needed.

active_parameters_b.note: No developer-defined active-per-token count was found in the exact card, configuration or official comparison graphic after the fresh targeted search. SiliconFlow lists 9B activated without developer provenance or a counting definition, so that secondary claim is not adopted. Dense architecture and nominal or non-embedding size alone do not establish an active count, especially with vision and optional MTP.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated full attention, plus vision encoder. Family-level MoE marketing in the card does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: Native token limit; the card separately describes configured extension to 1010000.

modalities.note: Exact-model examples cover all three inputs and text responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model server commands configure tool-call parsing and automatic tool choice.

description.value: Open-weight multimodal Qwen model with hybrid attention, optional thinking, and tool use.
description.note: Revised to identify multimodal capability and the documented hybrid-attention design without performance claims.

patch.description: Open-weight multimodal Qwen model with hybrid attention, optional thinking, and tool use.
patch.notes: 9B is the nominal language-model size. Complete checkpoint: 9.653104368B parameters, comprising language model and LM head 8.953803264B, vision 0.456010480B and MTP 0.243290624B. Qwen does not separately specify active parameters. Native context is 262144; larger context requires extension configuration.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirms the 9.653104368B complete-checkpoint total and preserves all component counts. Qwen publishes a nominal 9B language-model size but no separate active count in the exact card or official comparison graphic. A secondary 9B-activated listing lacks developer provenance; active parameters remain explicitly null/undisclosed. Prior non-parameter findings are unchanged.
